title: Order status
html:
<script>const s = whiteboard.scene({ columns: 2 });
const client = s.actor({ id: "client", at: [1, 1], title: "Client", note: "createOrder()" });
const queue = s.store({ id: "queue", at: [2, 1], title: "Queue" });
s.link(client, queue, { label: "enqueue", enter: "change" });
s.send(client, queue, "order", "change");
s.on("change", queue, { note: "1 pending", tone: "added" });
queue.item("order", { enter: "change", tone: "added" });
s.peek("status", { at: [1, 2, 1, 2], enter: "change" });</script>
